```{r}
nacc_antic <- readRDS("Results/neural/main_models/Nacc_antic_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl_tidy.Rds")

caudate_antic <- readRDS("Results/neural/main_models/caudate_antic_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl_tidy.Rds")

putamen_antic <- readRDS("Results/neural/main_models/putamen_antic_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl_tidy.Rds")

nacc_rresp <- readRDS("Results/neural/main_models/Nacc_rresp_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl_tidy.Rds")

caudate_rresp <- readRDS("Results/neural/main_models/caudate_rresp_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl_tidy.Rds")

putamen_rresp <- readRDS("Results/neural/main_models/putamen_rresp_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl_tidy.Rds")
```


```{r}

add_meta <- function(df, roi, contrast) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      ROI = roi,
      contrast = contrast
    )
}

all_models <- bind_rows(
  add_meta(nacc_antic,    "NAcc",    "anticipation"),
  add_meta(caudate_antic, "Caudate", "anticipation"),
  add_meta(putamen_antic, "Putamen", "anticipation"),
  add_meta(nacc_rresp,    "NAcc",    "receipt"),
  add_meta(caudate_rresp, "Caudate", "receipt"),
  add_meta(putamen_rresp, "Putamen", "receipt")
)

all_models

```

```{r}
adversity_terms <- c(
  "cg_psych",
  "ses_dis_nsafety",
  "primary_cg_lack_supp",
  "second_cg_lack_supp",
  "yp_family_conflict",
  "cg_sub_use_bio_sep",
  "family_anger_arg",
  "family_aggression",
  "trauma_exposure",
  "lack_supervision"
)

adversity_fdr <- all_models %>%
  filter(term %in% adversity_terms) %>%
  group_by(term, contrast) %>%   # <-- key change
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()



```

# adjust code for each adversity factor

```{r}
adversity_fdr %>%
  filter(term == "lack_supervision") %>%
  select(term, ROI, contrast, p.value, p_fdr)

```
